exercises.title: Bài 1 · What is inside a car?
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
A modern vehicle is a complex system of many parts that work together. The chassis is the frame that carries everything else, and the bodywork protects the passengers. The engine produces power, and the transmission sends it through the drivetrain to the wheels. The gearbox and the clutch let the driver change gear, while the differential allows the wheels to turn at different speeds in a corner.

Other systems keep the car safe and comfortable. The suspension, with its shock absorbers, absorbs bumps from the road. The steering system lets the driver choose the direction, and the brakes slow the vehicle down. The radiator cools the engine, and the alternator charges the battery while the engine is running.

Today, many manufacturers are developing new types of vehicles. For example, at the moment they are adding more electronics to the dashboard and are changing the way drivers interact with their cars.

content.q: The chassis carries the other parts of the vehicle.
content.why: Đoạn 1: khung gầm mang các bộ phận còn lại.

content.q: The differential makes all wheels turn at the same speed.
content.why: Đoạn 1: vi sai cho phép bánh xe quay với tốc độ **khác nhau** ở góc cua.

content.q: The radiator cools the engine.
content.why: Đoạn 2: két nước làm mát động cơ.

content.q: The alternator slows the vehicle down.
content.why: Đoạn 2: máy phát điện sạc ắc quy; **phanh** làm xe chậm lại.

content.q: What does the bodywork do?
content.why: Đoạn 1: vỏ xe bảo vệ hành khách.

content.q: What do the gearbox and clutch allow the driver to do?

content.q: What does the suspension do?

content.q: What are manufacturers doing at the moment?
content.why: Đoạn 3: đang bổ sung thêm thiết bị điện tử vào bảng điều khiển.
opts: Adding more electronics to the dashboard

exercises.title: Bài 1 · How an engine works
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
Most cars still use an internal combustion engine. Inside the engine, fuel and air are mixed and burned in the cylinders. This combustion pushes the pistons down, and the crankshaft converts their movement into rotation. The camshaft opens and closes the valves so that air enters and exhaust gases leave at the right moment.

Most engines use a four-stroke cycle: intake, compression, combustion and exhaust. In a petrol engine, a spark plug ignites the mixture. A diesel engine does not need a spark plug because the air is compressed much more strongly, so it becomes hotter. As a result, diesel engines are usually more efficient than petrol engines, but they are also noisier.

Engineers always try to make engines more powerful and cleaner. A turbocharger forces more air into the cylinders, so a small engine can produce as much power as a larger one. A catalytic converter reduces harmful emissions, and the ECU controls the whole process.

content.q: Combustion pushes the pistons down.
content.why: Đoạn 1: quá trình cháy đẩy pít-tông xuống.

content.q: A diesel engine needs a spark plug.
content.why: Đoạn 2: động cơ diesel **không cần** bugi vì không khí bị nén nóng.

content.q: Diesel engines are usually noisier than petrol engines.
content.why: Đoạn 2: diesel thường hiệu quả hơn nhưng ồn hơn.

content.q: A turbocharger removes air from the cylinders.
content.why: Đoạn 3: bộ tăng áp ép **thêm** không khí vào xi lanh.

content.q: What does the crankshaft do?
content.why: Đoạn 1: chuyển chuyển động của pít-tông thành chuyển động quay.
opts: Converts the movement of the pistons into rotation

content.q: What are the four strokes?
Why can a small turbocharged engine produce as much power as a larger one?

opts: A turbocharger forces more air into the cylinders

content.q: What does a catalytic converter do?
content.why: Đoạn 3: giảm khí thải độc hại.

exercises.title: Bài 1 · Building a car
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
Car manufacturing is a complex process. First, steel sheets are stamped into body panels by large presses. The panels are then welded together in the body shop, where most of the work is done by robots. Engine blocks are made by casting, and many parts are machined to an exact tolerance.

After welding, the body is cleaned and painted in the paint shop. Then it is moved to the assembly line, where engines, seats, wiring and wheels are installed. Components are delivered by suppliers just in time, so factories do not need to store large quantities.

Quality is checked at every stage. Each car is inspected, and the engine is tested before the vehicle leaves the plant. If a defect is found, the part is replaced. When a serious problem is discovered after sale, the manufacturer may recall the cars so that they can be repaired free of charge.

content.q: Cars are inspected only after they are sold.
content.why: Đoạn 3: chất lượng được kiểm tra ở **mọi giai đoạn**, trước khi xe rời nhà máy.

exercises.title: Bài 1 · Keeping drivers safe
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
Road safety depends on drivers, roads and vehicles. Modern cars have many safety systems. A seat belt and an airbag protect the passengers in a collision, and the crumple zone absorbs energy so that the cabin stays strong. ABS prevents the wheels from locking when the driver brakes hard, and stability control helps to prevent skidding.

Before a new model is sold, it has to pass crash tests and must receive type approval. Manufacturers must also meet emission standards. Safety organizations give each car a safety rating so that buyers can compare models.

Drivers have responsibilities too. They must wear a seat belt, and they mustn't use a phone while driving. They don't have to buy the most expensive car, but they should check the tire pressure regularly and have the vehicle inspected. Many new cars also have driver assistance systems, such as lane departure warning and adaptive cruise control, which should help to reduce accidents.

content.q: New models don't have to pass crash tests.
content.why: Đoạn 2: mẫu xe mới **phải** vượt qua thử nghiệm va chạm.

content.q: Drivers mustn't use a phone while driving.
content.why: Đoạn 3: người lái không được dùng điện thoại khi lái xe.

content.q: Drivers have to buy the most expensive car.
content.why: Đoạn 3: họ **không cần** mua xe đắt nhất.

content.q: What does ABS do?

opts: Prevents the wheels from locking when the driver brakes hard

content.q: What should drivers do regularly?

content.q: What can lane departure warning and adaptive cruise control do?

exercises.title: Bài 1 · The future of mobility
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
Electric vehicles are becoming more popular every year. An EV has no exhaust, so it produces zero emissions while driving, and an electric motor is quieter and more efficient than a petrol engine. If drivers use renewable energy to charge the battery, the carbon footprint of the vehicle will be much smaller.

However, there are challenges. If the range is too short, people suffer from range anxiety. If there are not enough charging stations, long journeys become difficult. Many experts say that if batteries had higher energy density and charged faster, more people would buy EVs. Regenerative braking helps because it recovers energy when the car slows down.

Autonomous vehicles use lidar, radar and cameras, and software combines the data in a process called sensor fusion. If the system detects an obstacle, the vehicle brakes automatically. If cars were fully self-driving, there would probably be fewer accidents, but the technology must still be tested carefully.

content.q: An EV produces zero emissions while driving.
content.why: Đoạn 1: xe điện không có ống xả nên không phát thải khi chạy.

content.q: If the range is too short, people may suffer from range anxiety.
content.why: Đoạn 2: phạm vi ngắn gây lo lắng về quãng đường.

content.q: Regenerative braking uses more energy from the battery.
content.why: Đoạn 2: phanh tái sinh **thu hồi** năng lượng khi xe giảm tốc.

content.q: Autonomous vehicles use only one sensor.
content.why: Đoạn 3: dùng lidar, radar và camera, kết hợp bằng sensor fusion.

content.q: What would make the carbon footprint smaller?
content.why: Đoạn 1: dùng năng lượng tái tạo để sạc.
opts: Charging the battery with renewable energy

content.q: What would happen if batteries had higher energy density and charged faster?
content.why: Đoạn 2: nhiều người sẽ mua xe điện hơn.

content.q: What does regenerative braking do?
content.why: Đoạn 2: thu hồi năng lượng khi xe giảm tốc.
opts: Charges the car from the grid

exercises.title: Bài 1 · A car that wouldn't start
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
Last Friday, Minh's car stalled on the way to work. A warning light came on, and the engine would not start again. He called a mechanic, who arrived within an hour. The mechanic connected a diagnostic tool to the on-board diagnostics port and read a fault code. It showed that one cylinder had a misfire.

The mechanic checked the spark plugs and found that they were badly worn. He also noticed a small oil leak. He replaced all four spark plugs, changed the oil and did a road test. After that, the engine ran smoothly.

Since then, Minh has followed the service interval in the repair manual. He has changed the oil twice, and he has also rotated the tires. He has learned that regular maintenance is cheaper than a breakdown. The warranty did not cover the problem, because the car was already five years old.

content.q: Minh's car stalled on the way to work.
content.why: Đoạn 1: xe chết máy trên đường đi làm.

content.q: The mechanic arrived after a whole day.
content.why: Đoạn 1: thợ đến trong vòng một giờ.

content.q: The fault code showed a misfire in one cylinder.
content.why: Đoạn 1: mã lỗi cho thấy một xi lanh bị bỏ máy.

content.q: The warranty covered the problem.
content.why: Đoạn 3: bảo hành **không** bao gồm vì xe đã năm tuổi.

content.q: What did the mechanic connect to the car?

content.why: Đoạn 3: theo chu kỳ bảo dưỡng và thay dầu hai lần.
